tldr.hook: Iran's IRGC Navy says three oil tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire.
points: Iran said two tankers struck naval mines in the eastern strait; blasts set all three ablaze.
Iran said US air cover failed to prevent the incidents and that it would release footage.
Qatar's PM met US Vice President JD Vance in Washington and backed diplomatic efforts.

stories.summary: The IRGC Navy's late-Monday statement was still unverified on Tuesday. Two ships had US air escort, it says. Qatar's PM: the region 'cannot withstand another escalation'.

tldr.hook: Asian chip stocks jumped after Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia's CEO.
points: South Korea's Kospi rose as much as 8%; Samsung gained 9% and SK Hynix 11%.
Taiwan's Taiex surged 9% and TSMC hit its daily 10% limit; Japan's Nikkei 225 climbed 5%.
Huang returned 11 days after resigning; Nvidia shares rose 31.5% on Monday.

tldr.hook: Russian jets neared South Korea's airspace; Seoul scrambled fighters and issued an alert
points: About five Russian aircraft entered the air defense zone near Ulleung Island; no airspace breach.
A provincial alert named the planes as suspected North Korean; officials later corrected it.
Seoul conveyed regret to Russia and called in its military attache, Nikolai Marchenko.

tldr.hook: Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali will fly on Shenzhou-24 to Tiangong
points: Launch set for 8:18 a.m. Beijing time Wednesday from Jiuquan with Tang Hongbo, Wu Yi and Ali.
Ali, a payload specialist and military pilot, becomes Pakistan's first astronaut in space.
His stay is brief; he returns with two Shenzhou-23 astronauts while Zhu Yangzhu stays a year.

tldr.hook: Australia won Greens backing for online safety law; fines up to 5% of global revenue
points: Platforms must cut foreseeable harm; Australians gain a right to sue over breaches of the duty.
Maximum penalty rises from A$109 million ($72.16 million) to 5% of a company's global revenue.
The US ambassador said vaguely defined harms will push platforms to censor lawful speech.

tldr.hook: A magnitude-5.6 earthquake struck eastern Nepal near the China border on Tuesday.
points: The epicentre was at Olangchung Gola in Taplejung district, about 275 km east of Kathmandu.
The EMSC put the magnitude at 5.3 and said it occurred at a depth of 10 kilometres.
No casualties or damage were reported immediately.

tldr.hook: The EU's new migration pact will relocate 1,283 asylum seekers in 2026, not 30,000.
points: Only 562 have been transferred so far, all from Cyprus to Lithuania, Romania, Bulgaria and France.
EU interior ministers agreed on 21,000 relocations and €420 million in contributions.
Hungary and Slovakia refused to contribute anything.

Zamfara suspended campaign activities in Maru Local Government Area after the crash.

tldr.hook: CAS restored Senegal's 1-0 AFCON 2025 final win over Morocco
points: The panel ruled the referee's decision to resume play in the 109th minute was within his authority.
CAS said Articles 82 and 84 did not apply because the referee did not abandon the match permanently.
CAF had declared Senegal to have forfeited and awarded Morocco a 3-0 win; the ruling was unanimous.
